shared_regression.purpose: Finite implementation regression, not a universal proof.

interpretation: Current frozen source generates the v2 report. The older v1 report is its exact unchanged projection, not an output byte-match from this current source main. No older source code was reconstructed or run.
limits: Regression enumerates all solver-supported ordered outcome paths for its 30 generated instances; only one full-history certificate per instance is replayed. Obstruction paths are explicitly not SPE. Analytic all-cover strings are not finite enumeration of all fractional covers.
